paragraphs: RecTimes sells scheduling software for sports facilities, built for managing venue schedules, collecting payments and filling bookings. The home page dates the company to 2012 and describes a scheduling, invoicing, and contract management solution.

Customers can see the facility schedule and available time slots in real-time, make booking requests, or pay online with a credit card. Email and SMS notifications go to staff, and invoices and agreements are created from the booking list and emailed to the customer. Single and repeat bookings can be made in seconds, changed with a drag and drop feature, and customers notified of changes by email.

The software is described as scaling for every sports facility type, from single rinks to towns with 50+ venues. Venue types listed include ice rinks, soccer fields, gymnasiums, tennis courts, swimming pools and golf simulators. The page names companies and towns as the customers that use it. Bookings made with the software are counted at over $225,337,967 on the same page.

quote.text: Built specifically for sports facilities, RecTimes provides everything you need to manage your venue schedules, collect instant payments, and fill more bookings.
